# GUI Interface Description

## System Top Bar
- **Date and Time**: "Oct 22 21:04" centered in the top bar.
- **Notification Icon**: Bell icon to the right of the date and time.
- **System Indicators**: Group of icons on the far right including:
  - Network connectivity icon
  - Sound/volume control icon
  - Power button icon

## Desktop Environment
- **Background**: Geometric abstract wallpaper with gradient from deep purple to red-orange.
- **Desktop Icon**: Single "Home" folder icon located at the bottom right corner of the screen.

## Left Dock (Application Launcher)
- **Application Icons (Top to Bottom)**:
  - Google Chrome browser
  - Thunderbird email client
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC media player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP image editor
  - Ubuntu Software Center
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Terminal icon (command line)
  - Trash icon

## File Manager Window
- **Window Title Bar**: Displays "Home / Downloads" indicating current directory.
- **Navigation Controls**:
  - Back button (left arrow)
  - Forward button (right arrow)
  - Home button (house icon)
  - Search icon (magnifying glass)
  - More options button (three vertical dots)
- **View Options**:
  - List view button (three horizontal lines)
  - Dropdown menu for view options
  - Grid view button (three horizontal lines with dots)
- **Window Controls**:
  - Minimize button
  - Maximize button
  - Close button (X)
- **Sidebar Navigation**:
  - Recent
  - Starred
  - Home
  - Desktop
  - Documents
  - Downloads (currently selected, highlighted in gray)
  - Music
  - Pictures
  - Videos
  - Trash
  - Other Locations (with plus icon)
- **File List**:
  - **MediaLibrary.zip**: ZIP archive file with teal icon.
  - **locked**: Folder with red "locked" label.
  - **license.key**: File with PGP key icon.
  - **decrypt.sh**: File with shell script icon.
- **Selection Status Bar**: At the bottom of the file manager window, displays "“locked” selected (containing 2 items)".

## Terminal Window
- **Window Title Bar**: Displays "user@user-virtual-machine: ~" indicating the user and home directory.
- **Terminal Interface**:
  - Command prompt: "user@user-virtual-machine:~$"
  - Cursor: Blinking rectangle (text cursor) after the prompt.
- **Window Controls**:
  - Minimize button
  - Maximize button
  - Close button (X)
- **Terminal Menu and Search**:
  - Search icon (magnifying glass)
  - Menu button (three horizontal lines)
- **Terminal Appearance**:
  - Dark background with light text.
  - Terminal prompt is displayed in green text.
  - No command history or output visible.

## Mouse Cursor
- **Position**: Located in the lower right area of the file manager window, near the bottom edge.
